notes.subject: test(mcp): add manual-smoke testbed MCP server and checklist
notes.summary: Adds a manual-smoke MCP testbed server and checklist under node-host test fixtures; it is test-only and does not change any shipped behaviour.

notes.subject: feat(mcp): show elicitation as an Activity Shelf card with Decline and a tool-row summary
notes.summary: MCP form and URL requests now appear as an Activity Shelf card with separate Decline and Cancel actions, readable field labels and optional markers, and the tool row records the answers; progress without a total no longer repeats the count.

notes.subject: fix(mcp): let a pending elicitation card take over the Activity Shelf
notes.summary: A pending MCP request card now takes over the Activity Shelf, hiding the task list, opening tall enough to fit, and keeping its action buttons pinned to the bottom when the form scrolls.
